description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton object `LocalDataSource` responsible for providing static or mock content for an Android app. It loads local JSON data from assets, caches it in memory, and offers various methods to retrieve home data, workout lists, and workout details, including fallback mechanisms if the data cannot be loaded. The file also includes data classes representing the local content schema.

classes.name: LocalContent
classes.description: Data class representing the schema of the local content loaded from assets, including home, workouts, and detailed workout information.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the data source with the application context; should be called in Application.onCreate.

methods.name: getHome
methods.description: Returns the home screen data, including favorites, recent, continue watching, and categories.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Filters and returns a list of workouts based on optional category, level, and duration range.

methods.name: getWorkout
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific workout by ID, synthesizing minimal details if explicit data is absent.

methods.name: getOrLoad
methods.description: Retrieves cached data or loads from assets if cache is empty.

methods.name: loadFromAssets
methods.description: Reads JSON data from assets and deserializes it into `LocalContent`. Falls back to hardcoded data on failure.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Checks whether the application context has been set; throws if not.

methods.name: fallbackContent
methods.description: Creates a fallback `LocalContent` instance with hardcoded demo data.
